judge.rationale: Fully answers the scoping brief: preserves all three sources and their roles, records S2/S3 as abstract-level, leaves cohort overlap unresolved with symmetric very-low certainty, and specifies the dates/identifiers/eligibility needed. Neutral on shared database use; no clinical advice. Field-level disclosure of full-text checks is transparent and does not mislabel abstracts as full text.
